note: Live rounds. A reading nothing has ever been fired at is a reading nobody has reason to trust, so this file is what the unarmed count on the headline is computed against. The edits array has no ceiling: the retired instrument budgeted one edit per round and one of its readings therefore went a whole session with no ammunition at all. Rounds whose form is a fixture rather than an edit carry a fixture field and record the run that fired them.

unarmed_declaration.note: Readings with no round yet. Listed so the count on the headline has somewhere to point, and so nobody has to read the catalogue to find out what is undefended. Every entry here is a debt, not an exemption. The text readings are on this list too: they are not counted as assays, so they do not reach the headline's unarmed number, and that is the more reason to write them down here.

runner_status.note: There is no breach runner yet -- req/06 §8-2 puts it at stage I5. Until it exists the rounds above are fired by two probes, by hand, and their results are written into the fired field of each row. That is weaker than a runner in exactly one way, and it is named here rather than left to be discovered: nothing re-fires these rounds on every run, so a row's fired field can go stale without anything saying so.
